a: Ask your Democratic senator to vote for Chris Van Hollen for Senate Majority Leader on December 1.
d:
Senator Chris Van Hollen of Maryland announced on November 12 that he will challenge Senator Chuck Schumer for Senate Majority Leader. The Democratic caucus votes by secret ballot on December 1, and the winner needs 28 of the 55 caucus votes to lead the new Senate majority when Congress convenes in January. It is the first contested Senate Democratic leadership election since 1994.

Van Hollen says voters called for change and that Democrats should use the full power of the Senate to end the Iran war and lower the cost of living. He has voted repeatedly to block offensive weapons sales to Israel and has pressed for conditions on military aid. The choice of leader will decide how the majority uses its power — contact your senator now, before the December 1 vote.

Dear {title} {last},

My name is {name} and I live in {city}. I am writing to ask you to support Senator Chris Van Hollen for Senate Majority Leader when the Democratic caucus votes by secret ballot on December 1. This is the first contested leadership election in the Senate since 1994, and the choice will shape how our new majority uses its power.

Senator Van Hollen has said he would use the full power of the Senate to end the Iran war and lower the cost of living, and he has promised not to intervene in party primaries for open Senate seats. He has also voted repeatedly to block offensive weapons sales to Israel and pressed for conditions on military aid, a record that matters to me as your constituent.

Please vote for Senator Van Hollen on December 1 and let me know where you stand. Thank you for your service.

Sincerely,
{name}
